abstract.text: A decoded JSON Web Signature header containing transaction or renewal information.
The algorithm used for signing the JSON Web Signature (JWS).
The X.509 certificate chain that corresponds to the key that the App Store used to secure the JWS.

paragraphs.text: All JWS representations, including the `signedPayload`, contain a JWS header. When you Base64 URL-decode the header, use the `JWSDecodedHeader` object to read its contents. Use the information in the `JWSDecodedHeader` to validate the JWS signature. For more information about validating signatures, see the JSON Web Signature (JWS) `https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7515` specification.
